description: This file defines an interface for a hardware-optimized composition buffer within the WPEFramework exchange namespace. It includes a main interface ICompositionBuffer with nested structures IPlane and IIterator, providing methods to access buffer planes, perform rendering, and query buffer properties.

classes.name: ICompositionBuffer
classes.description: An interface representing a composition buffer optimized for hardware use, providing methods to access buffer planes, identify buffer type, manage reference counting, and render.

classes.name: IPlane
classes.description: A nested interface within ICompositionBuffer representing a single plane of the buffer, providing access to its data, stride, and offset.

classes.name: IIterator
classes.description: A nested interface within ICompositionBuffer to iterate over the planes, with methods to check validity, move to next plane, and access current plane.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increment reference count for this buffer object.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrement reference count, potentially destroying the object.

methods.name: Identifier
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for the buffer.

methods.name: Planes
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the buffer's planes, with a timeout parameter.

methods.name: Completed
methods.description: Notify that the buffer is done with its planes, optionally indicating if the content is dirty.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Mark the buffer for display scanout.

methods.name: Width
methods.description: Returns the width of the buffer in pixels.

methods.name: Height
methods.description: Returns the height of the buffer in pixels.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Returns the format of the pixel layout.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the data type of the buffer (invalid, DMA, raw).
